outputs.description: Corrected coefficients for the cubic polynomial ΔfG°(γ‑CaSO₄)/(kJ·mol⁻¹) = a + b·T + 1.1620×10⁻⁴·T² – 7.0810×10⁻⁸·T³. Scoring compares a and b against hidden gold values with absolute tolerance.
Equilibrium water vapour pressures for the three dehydration reactions over 300‑600 K. The checker recomputes log10(P) at selected temperatures and compares against hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The corrected polynomial coefficients are treated as fixed deterministic values (exact_match); the equilibrium curves are scored by recomputing log10(P) and comparing to a hidden reference; the isotherms are scored by structural checks (monotonic trend) and threshold comparisons at selected points.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold polynomial coefficients, equilibrium pressure reference values, and isotherm key point thresholds derived from the paper.
